How this list is made: each item was checked against the lab's own announcement or a reputable report, and links to it. Dates are announcement or release dates; where only the month could be confirmed, the card shows the month. Benchmark and price figures are as the lab announced them. Coverage is deepest for labs whose announcements we could check directly, so a lab with fewer cards has not necessarily shipped less. Spot a missing or wrong item? Every entry lives in one file, data/lab-updates.json.
